name: Analyze logs
description:
Here's a 5-line summary:

1. A new **`LogAIView.vue`** component was created to provide AI-powered log analysis using a temporary task-mode chat.
2. The component initializes a chat via **`createNewChat`** and sends logs to **`chatWithProject`** for AI analysis.
3. It **auto-analyzes new logs** when they arrive if the chat is already initialized, and cleans up the temp chat on unmount.
4. **`LogViewer.vue`** was updated to include an **"AI View" toggle button** in the header that switches between the normal log view and the AI analysis panel.
5. The AI panel renders the chat using the existing **`ChatView`** component and passes `rawLogs` as a prop from the log store.

messages.content: Add a "AI view" button that will create a quick Chat in task mode and show it instead the logs. When refreshing the logs will be added to the chat and call chatWithProject to get a log analysis
